A fantasy-loving family decides to build their own underground home in the hills of Virginia; with shipment delays, errors and severe weather, the couple must fight to make their dream world a reality.
In an effort to spend more time with their kids, a couple sets out to build a treehouse in remote Maryland.

Marty re-rescues the Broadhead family, whose Ohio home was made from 30,000 tires and faces major new structural issues. Taking on a big challenge with limited time, Marty must restore a settling berm and construct a concrete storm.

Novice but passionate farmsteaders in Iowa are on the verge of losing the legacy of their late father. The Raneys must quickly give them an off-grid masterclass and help them complete one of the unique rescues ever.
In Hawaii the Raneys attempt to save two homesteaders whose dream homestead lies in a flash-flood zone. As the weather closes in, can they save the property from the water?
The team gets creative while trying to make something worthwhile out of a lackluster cabin.

In May 2024, dozens of eyewitnesses captured rare twin tornadoes as they carved a parallel path of destruction across Iowa. With winds near 300 mph, the twister sisters toppled farms, shredded wind turbines and devastated the town of Greenfield.
Challenges faced by those running Spain's busiest harbours.
Challenges faced by those running Spain's busiest harbours.

Two scout teams attempt gruelling journeys to reach a signal tower. One team struggles to crest a jungle ridgeline, and the other takes on 12 miles of Lost Coast seas. And a survivalist slips out of consciousness.
Experts investigate the secrets of seven lost cities; investigators use advanced aerial scanning, underwater drones, and 3-D mapping to reveal why these enigmatic civilisations disappeared.
Bruce heads to Ypres looking for items from WWI, finding a German trench mortar. He also goes for a ride in a WWI-era British tank - one of the first tanks ever used in combat.
Bruce finds a picture in his attic from Dunkirk, given to him by a soldier who was there. Bruce and Hus go on a hunt for kit that tells the real story of the evacuation.
A client wants a German half-track armoured personnel carrier converted into a Pioneer variant, used by the German army during the Battle of the Bulge.
Henry and Fuzz view an exquisite collection of military and civilian vehicles in Guildford. What will they sell to the drummer from a British rock band?
Henry and Fuzz sail over to the Isle of Wight. They meet Vince, a fanatical collector whose sheds are bursting with British and Japanese bikes.
In Brackley, Henry and Fuzz are overwhelmed by Nick's military collection.
Henry and Fuzz rummage through David's hoard of Italian bikes in Norfolk.
James is washed up on a remote island in the shark-infested waters of the South Pacific, as he explores how marooned crews of some of the worst shipping disasters survived.
Lockheed were tasked with creating a plane invisible to Russian radar, capable of reaching an altitude of 80,000 ft and speeds of Mach 3.2.
Emerging as a rival to Boeing's 247, the rigorously tested twin-engine DC-3 would eventually radicalise the aviation industry in 1934.
A French museum asks Bruce for help in acquiring an incredibly rare German Panzer 1 tank. He also explores the remains of secret underground Nazi war factories.
Bruce helps a Texan millionaire who wants to collect memorabilia from the Battle of Normandy. He visits farmhouses and museums to find rare items like a 1942 Luger.
A Hollywood blockbuster needs an authentic WWII SAS jeep within two weeks. It's a tight deadline, but Bruce is determined to meet it, as the wartime SAS is a passion of his.

Could the World's Greatest Motorcycle Ride be only 37 miles long? Well, it might not be a gruelling adventure, but the Isle of Man is home to the most famous road race in the world; the Isle of Man TT. For presenter Henry Cole, this circuit is motorcycling Mecca, but what has the Isle of Man got to offer away from the racing?
Starting in Auckland in the North Island Henry Cole sets off on two wheels but soon takes to air and sea to see more of the breathtaking scenery New Zealand is justly famed for.
Henry Cole continues to ride his Harley-Davidson through the South Island. His route takes him through primeval forests and lovely west coast towns like Greymouth.

Nearly a decade after the ancient site of Nimrud was destroyed by terrorists, experts return to salvage the wreckage; archaeologists piece together the remaining ruins to reveal the origins and brutal decline of a lost empire.

The ancient necropolis of Abusir contains strange megastructures unlike any discovered in Egypt; experts gain rare access to investigate lost tombs and forgotten rituals to reveal the secrets of Egypt's Sun Cult pharaohs.
Palmyra: pearl of the Syrian Desert; experts return to the site and use CGI reconstruction to reveal the secrets of Palmyra's ancient engineers.
Paper conservator Ashleigh is tasked with restoring a 1967 James Bond film poster. And, Drew asks metalworker Ted to revamp a peculiar hardwood globe.

Drew asks Michael and Maria to repair a rare automaton from Scotland. Plus, upholsterer Ray is challenged to rescue an Edwardian slipper chair, a special kind of chair developed to seat high-class women while they put on their shoes.

The restorers are turning their hands to some old medical equipment. Sculptor Nick revives an antique anatomy model in need of urgent medical attention. Alex turns a scientific specimen cabinet into a pair of attractive cupboards.

Experts reveal all-new evidence and theories related to Bigfoot, the world's most famous cryptid. Eyewitness accounts combined with recently uncovered evidence reveal a creature far more fierce and predatory than the gentle giant often depicted.

After centuries of believing the Loch Ness Monster dwells deep within Scotland's Loch Ness, a new theory paints a different story. Experts explore evidence suggesting the monster may not only be real, but possibly more dangerous than ever imagined.
Experts investigate whether an interdimensional portal in the Alaska Triangle led to the disappearance of an aeroplane carrying 44 military personnel in 1950.
Bigfoot hunters investigate whether ape-like beast is responsible for a string of disappearances.
How do they turn used aluminium cans into planes and rockets? Plus, how do they carve the traditional Black Forest cuckoo clock?
How do they build the ultimate car crushing colossus? Plus, how do Lea and Perrins concoct their Worcestershire sauce?
A look at how the amazing, and massive, decorations on Mardi Gras carnival floats are created, how rock candy is twisted together, and a look at how dentures are made.
The miraculous feats of engineering that underpin our lives, from the most basic of everyday objects to the biggest and most complex. This episode focuses on crash helmets, rubber, and wave piercing.
Clayton returns to his ranch in Montana to hunt for quick finds at Old Faithful. In Wyoming, Mike Harris and his team continue excavating their triceratops site hoping to uncover the valuable horns.

In Montana, Clayton Phipps prepares to learn if his carnivore skeleton belongs to a T. rex or the controversial Nanotyrannus. Meanwhile in Wyoming, Mike Harris and Aaron Bolan race against the impending winter digging at a promising new site.
Insight into the production processes of wooden matches, tillage machines, telescopic gangways, and mabe pearls.
Find out how mosquito coils, solar-assist tricycles, palm oil, and fibreglass chopper guns are made and why they are so in demand.
Insight into the production processes of wood toys, retro toasters, Laboratory Furnaces, and Aerogels.
Examines how items such as combination squares, farmed shrimp, ball valves, and string trimmers are made.
A look at the world's finest oyster knives, the lights transforming the world's most popular sport and how pure diamonds grown in a greenhouse are creating a gemstone revolution.
How do they make cheddar, the world's most popular cheese? How do they breathe life into Resusci Anne, the plastic woman that teaches CPR?
How does Ford produce the ubiquitous white van, the Transit? Plus, how do they ensure the Driza-Bone coat lives up to its name?

We uncover the miraculous feats of engineering which underpin life in the 21st century. How they make wood-burning stoves that bring warmth to the bleak Norwegian winter. Plus, how to build the synthesiser that changed music forever, and more.
This massive hydroelectric project aims to decrease Rio de Janeiro's frequent blackouts.
Adam joins forces with a NASA engineer to rebuild a rocket-propelled super weapon. Originally built to breach barbed wire in WWII, they aim to fix its fatal flaws.

US astronauts Doug Hurley and Bob Behnken return to Earth in a watery splashdown that caps a milestone NASA and SpaceX mission; live coverage of their return reveals what they discovered and what it takes to come home.
From a miraculous pyramid in Central America to ancient Greek myths, Josh shares the mysteries of the most awesome places on Earth.

From the castle that inspired the home of an iconic vampire to the market where Santa's devilish sidekick stalks and scares holiday revellers, Josh tells the stories of places where legends never die.

Josh explores the beauty of the spiritual realm. He investigates a German basilica said to house the bones of 11,000 virgins, a Japanese ice cave guarded by a dragon's spirit and a remote island where cats outnumber humans.
Josh investigates a millionaire's disappearance in Malaysia, an ancient city's collapse in Cambodia and a celebration of death in Bolivia.
John D. Rockefeller, the king of kerosene, and Thomas Scott, the visionary behind the Pennsylvania Railroad, battle for control of America's new oil industry.
In the late 1800s two great minds, Thomas Edison and Nikola Tesla, built systems that would dramatically change life by bringing light and power to the world.
To find the truth behind unexplained phenomena, experts follow new clues to underwater alien anomalies that some believe have ties to the lost city of Atlantis.
Richard explores elements that engineering projects have in common, and he reveals how the challenges get bigger when something is built big.
Jason, Vicki and off-road enthusiast Jimmy de Ville pit the Land Rover Defender against the new Ineos Grenadier and test the 7-seater Dacia Jogger.
The team test the new Tesla Model 3 and the Jeep Avenger. Plus, there is a thrilling showdown between the Honda Civic Type-R and the Cupra Leon.
In the south of France, Vicki celebrates 60 years of the Ford Mustang. Plus, Jason pits the Ferrari 296 GTB against the McLaren 750S.

Locals face off in Ohio, and one racer manages to negotiate their races, getting further than anyone expected. Then, the $5,000 prize winner goes up against the infamous Kye Kelley -- but Kye is worried about how the race will go down.
Pennsylvania locals race for $5000. With Caden Rankin, the son of an NPK racer, in the field, all bets are off. The winner faces Axman, known for never backing down.
Competition reality, Documentary, Auto racing, Reality
Michiganders compete for $5,000, and a racing wagon surprises everyone. Then, the last local standing goes up against Bobby Ducote for another $5,000.
Henry and Fuzz motor over to Taff's place in Lincoln. His extensive collection of Easy Rider-style chopper motorbikes includes an engraved 1970s Yamaha.
Chris and Francis face huge setbacks with the wheels of their locomotive. The time and cost implications could be disastrous for the restoration.
Francis and Chris dig deep to help save their loco restoration when crisis hits. Will their high-risk strategy destroy their dream?
Chris and Francis try to make up lost time following lengthy wheel problems, but leaky brakes and a 12-tonne jigsaw stand in their way.
Chris and Francis install a 2.5 tonne traction motor, and head to the Highlands, revealing 37025's past and a family connection for Francis.
The day finally arrives when Chris and Francis attempt to start 025's engine, but after two years of silence there's no guarantee it'll work.

Henry and Sam continue their Northern Ireland adventure with Gordon. The luck of the Irish strikes and they get off to a great start, with lots to marvel at. They find army vehicles, tractors and some very well-hidden Land Rovers.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in the Queen's realm as they visit a shed in the shadow of Windsor Castle. Once again both boys are happy, as there are motorcycles galore, but will they get a bargain out of Roy?

Henry and Sam continue their travel around Northern Ireland and discover lovely vintage cars, along with some modern motors. Sam loves a Sunbeam-Talbot, Henry, a lovely Ford Capri. What will they take home as their last item of the season?
Presenter Henry Cole and motorcycle restorer Sam Lovegrove are in the Cotswolds to visit the largest sidecar manufacturer in Britain. They uncover a rusty Lancia Aurelia and a Royal Enfield 500.
In northern Italy, Mike and Elvis tackle the last truly analogue Ferrari, the 348. And this one is in dire need of a cambelt change.
Mike finds an Alfa Romeo GTV with some fails, but he reckons Elvis can sort it. Can he get it ready for an Italian road trip to re-create the GTV Cup?
Mike finds a rare, rally-bred 1972 Lancia Fulvia. He and Ant must fix its bad CV joints, a broken heater, cracked dash and a debris-clogged fuel system.
Mike finds a Fiat 600 imported recently; Fiat 500 has originated out of Fiat 600, a car that was massive on the Continent, but little seen elsewhere.
Mike tracks down a rare '91 Alfa Romeo 164L. He loves the look, but Ant has his work cut out for him. The car has perfect bodywork, but it has a leaking engine.
Richard Hammond travels to the giant Appomattox production platform in the Gulf of Mexico, where he reveals the cutting-edge engineering behind this high-tech facility and its record-breaking drills.

Ein Team von Weltklasse-Show-Wrestlern bietet den Fans zum ersten Mal seit 20 Jahren ein neues Wrestling-Erlebnis. Mit von der Partie sind Cody und Brandi Rhodes, Kenny Omega, Henker Adam Page, Chris Jericho und Jon Moxley.
Eine Nagelkette ist ein wirksames Mittel, um einen flüchtigen Pkw-Fahrer zu stoppen. Doch wenn der Raser ständig die Richtung wechselt, verringern sich die Erfolgsaussichten.

Ein Autofahrer ist in der englischen Grafschaft Northamptonshire der Aufforderung, anzuhalten, nicht nachgekommen. Der Mann ist möglicherweise alkoholisiert. Er rast bei tief stehender Sonne über Landstraßen und schreckt vor keinem Risiko zurück.

Stefan Zellweger bestaunt auf der Tour nach Alaska die atemberaubende Natur Nordamerikas. Aber auf den unwegsamen Straßen verrutscht die Ladung. Kai Nußbaum bricht unterdessen mit Wurstschneidemaschinen für die Industrie nach England auf.

Nach der Pandemie sind die Trucker wieder im Einsatz. Manuel, Christina und ihre Kollegen liefern unermüdlich Güter an Baustellen, Fabriken und Supermärkte. Der Alltag auf den Straßen ist hart. Doch die Leidenschaft für das Fahren ist ungebrochen.

Am Flughafen von Madrid können die Zollbeamten einen Zigarettenschmuggler überführen, der sich sehr viel Mühe gegeben hat, seine heiße Ware zu verbergen. In Barcelona wird die Guardia Civil auf eine Person aufmerksam, die Shisha-Tabak schmuggelt.

Sven und Rudi nehmen die letzte Etappe ihrer Tour von Niedersachsen nach Portugal in Angriff, denn das Duo soll einen Rennwagen nach Portimão überführen. Derweil hat Thorsten Eckert in Polen unter anderem Probleme mit dem Mautsystem.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Josh Gates geht den bekanntesten und faszinierendsten Legenden der Welt auf den Grund. Auf seinen Abenteuern lässt er nichts unversucht und reist zu den zentralen Schauplätzen, die eng mit den Mythen und Geschichten verbunden sind.

Der Schädelknochen eines Elefanten und ein Dixi-Klo: Pfandhausbesitzer Les Gold ist nicht begeistert, denn solche Objekte lassen sich nur schwer weiterverkaufen. Wenn die Besitzer sich dazu entschließen, die Gegenstände nicht innerhalb von drei Monaten auslösen, hat Les die Gegenstände für immer am Hals. Edelsteine sind da schon eher nach dem Geschmack des Pfandhaus-Besitzers. Vorausgesetzt, er bekommt die Juwelen zu einem Vorzugspreis.

Raubkatzen können ihre Krallen einziehen, deshalb stammen die Abdrücke, die Ky und Gabby im Schnee sehen, wahrscheinlich von einem Puma. Das bedeutet, die beiden müssen sehr wachsam sein, wenn sie ihren Unterschlupf verlassen.

Die Outdoor-Cracks werden in der Wildnis einem Medizincheck unterzogen und Sarahs Herz schlägt doppelt so schnell wie normal. Die Erklärung dafür liegt auf der Hand, den bei extremer Kälte versucht der Körper die Kerntemperatur zu erhöhen.

In Zone zwei herrscht ein tropisches Klima mit extremen Temperaturen und hoher Luftfeuchtigkeit. Die schwierigen Bedingungen setzen den Teams beim Überlebenskampf zu. Fernanda ist dehydriert und hat Fieber.

Borneo ist die drittgrößte Insel der Welt und zu großen Teilen mit tropischem Regenwald bedeckt. Survival-Profi Ed Stafford will es zehn Tage in dieser grünen Hölle aushalten, bei Temperaturen um die 40 Grad Celsius und einer Luftfeuchtigkeit von 90 Prozent. Über Wassermangel kann er sich auf dem Eiland nicht beklagen, doch dem ehemaligen Soldaten machen die lästigen Moskitos zu schaffen und eine entzündete Wunde am Fuß.
Team Salvage ist auf einer Mission, um eine Yacht aus einer Krokodilbrutstätte zu bergen.

Team Salvage ist in Lismore, New South Wales, unterwegs, um den Besitzern einer Rollschuhbahn dabei zu helfen, ihr Geschäft wieder auf die Beine zu stellen. Team West Coast versucht, einen Gifttransporter im Collie River zu bergen.

Die Abschlepp-Profis sollen im Brisbane River ein tonnenschweres Patrouillenboot aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg bergen, das seit zwei Jahren im Wasser liegt. Wie das klappen soll, muss sich das Team von Geographe Marine Salvage and Rescue noch überlegen.
Eine hoch verschuldete Person ist am Flughafen in Stockholm in einem teuren Auto unterwegs. Der Mann behauptet, der Wagen gehöre seinem Vater.

Ein Mann in einer grünen Jacke und seine Begleiterin sollen in einem Duty-Free-Laden am Stockholmer Flughafen mehrere Parfumflaschen gestohlen haben. Überwachungskameras erfassen die beiden verdächtigen Personen in der Nähe eines Restaurants.

Tony Beets' Team hat in 14 Wochen Gold im Wert von 17 Millionen Dollar zutage gefördert. Das ist eine beachtliche Ausbeute. Doch der "König des Klondike" will mehr. Auch Rick Ness zieht die Zügel an. Zeitdruck sorgt für Spannungen im Team.

Früher tourte Rick Ness als Bassist um die Welt, doch das liegt schon viele Jahre zurück. Heute sieht sein Leben ganz anders aus. Als Minenboss leitet er im Yukon die Geschicke eines Goldgräberteams. Rick will sich neues Land sichern, seine Mitarbeiter kämpfen sich in 14-Stunden-Schichten Meter für Meter ins Erdreich vor, und sie verbessern eine Straße, um den Betrieb effizienter zu machen. Noch ist ungewiss, ob sich all das am Ende auszahlen wird.

Alabama liegt östlich der Tornado Alley. Doch auch dort können Superzellen gefährliche Wirbelstürme hervorbringen, die verheerenden Schaden anrichten. Reed fährt mit dem Dominator mitten in die Gefahrenzone.

Da braut sich etwas zusammen: Rotierende Superzellen drohen, in der kanadischen Provinz Saskatchewan starke Tornados hervorzubringen. Den Storm Chasers bleibt die bedrohliche Wetterlage natürlich nicht verborgen.

Phil und Heather sind auf der Spur eines Vampirs, Chupacabra. Er treibt sein Unwesen in Texas. Die Legende begann 1995 auf Puerto Rico. Die Inselbewohner waren zutiefst beunruhigt wegen zahlreicher Angriffe auf ihre Nutztiere.
In Africa, a young girl undergoes a risky, life-saving operation on her huge face tumour.
In Mexico, eight-year-old Dany was born with Moebius Syndrome which paralysed her face. She is set to undergo delicate microsurgery. Will she smile for the first time?

The Cars' drummer David Robinson rolls into F40 with a restoration job on a rare 1969 De Tomaso Mangusta. A disagreement over the colour scheme has Wayne wanting to "Shake It Up," while David may be thinking "Bye Bye Love."
During a hunt for the perfect 32 Ford, Wayne finds a vintage ice-cutting machine with a motorcycle body and engine. Plus, he uncovers a Bugatti Type 55s replica.
Ferrari expert and renowned master car restorer Wayne Carini trawls the US and makes it his personal mission to uncover, restore and sell more classic cars.
Wayne has a classic 1931 Caddillac ready for auction, whilst he is in petrol head heaven when he has to restore the breaks on a recreation of a 1937 Bugatti Atlantique.
The crew faces a web of build and design issues customising a 1970s Pantera. The 6'4 client must be able to comfortably get into the car.

With the whole team in agreement over the body mods, the crew must make the designs into reality. Their list of tasks include bulging out the fenders, creating a spider-shaped exhaust, executing the stretch and getting the car to body.
The Pantera is almost done, but nothing is simple with this car. Plus, Dave and Kev get a chance to upgrade their semi rig.

A 1971 Chevy Nova with tremendous pedigree arrives at the shop to get classic Kindig-It styling cues; Dave wants to make this car into a hardtop; tucked-in bumpers, front valance and a new engine provide a good test for the crew.

After a disastrous test with the MGB, Richard warns the Cogs if they can't turn things around in time for the next race, he'll pull the plug on the whole project. Neil struggles to get the Lancia finished in time for a Goodwood auction.

The cogs go International restoring an iconic 1970s Royal Enfield Interceptor motorbike. An epic road trip ensues when Richard, Neil and Andrew decide to deliver the bike themselves to the cool Wheels and Waves festival in Biarritz.
A disaster of a 1975 Corvette has been sitting in a Police Officer's garage for 15 years. The Garage Squad will try to get this Corvette back in high speed pursuit.
A group of friends from high school spent their youth wrenching on Mopars. Now young men, they are back together with the Squad to rescue a 1971 Dodge Dart.
Using state-of-the-art science, Jeremy Wade chases new leads in pursuit of the Loch Ness monster's hiding place.
Jeremy Wade reveals the new deep-sea discoveries that might prove the existence of the infamous giant squid and looks at whether this underwater monster is the legendary kraken.

A lobsterman from Maine relives a harrowing encounter that has haunted him for years, a family witnesses a strange string of lights in the sky, and a man believes he can communicate with alien crafts.
A musician captures a strange object flying over a motorway in California. A tourist takes what could be the most compelling UFO photo ever, and two friends fear they were abducted on a road trip.

Hikers are going missing amid reports of grotesque, human-like creatures prowling Appalachia's Great Smoky Mountains; Phil and Jess venture into the unforgiving wilderness to investigate the truth behind terrifying sightings of feral people.
Ed Stafford is joined by Donny Dust, a former US Marine intelligence officer and primitive skills expert, in a race across the wild Amazon jungle.
Jimmy Carr and team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock are joined by celebrity guests Steve Jones, David O'Doherty, Deborah Meaden, and Seann Walsh.

Jimmy Carr plays host as Jon Richardson and Johnny Vegas take on Sean Lock and Romesh Ranganathan. Josie Long joins Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while Joe Wilkinson 'assists' Rachel Riley.
Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock are joined by celebrity guests Paul Hollywood, Dawn O'Porter, Joe Wilkinson and Rob Beckett.

Sea-loving groom, Dave wants to whisk his water-phobic bride-to-be, Rosie off to a remote island wedding, but it's not just any island, its windswept Lundy Island off the coast of Devon, where the bride once nearly drowned and had to be rescued.

Another brave bride leaves the most important day of her life in the hands of the man she loves. Harry Potter fan Sean needs all the help he can get planning spooky witches and wizards-themed wedding in a forest for his demanding bride-to-be Nicole. But with a fiancée set on a church for her big day and a best man who'd rather watch football than plan a wedding, will Sean be able to work his magic to pull off a spellbinding day to remember or will it all be just an illusion?
A couple's shoddy DIY renovations have actually decreased the value of their property, and now they are stuck in real estate limbo.
Tired of their monster commute, Jinny and Raymond want to trade their huge suburban heritage home for a turnkey property closer to the city. They call in the Property Brothers to help make it happen.
Club Med Europe Africa Middle East CEO Xavier Mufraggi goes undercover at his holiday parks.
In Sheffield, car salesman Paul and Sara, newlyweds Russell and Shane, and kooky duo Janine and Neil compete in an edition that features bickering, failed romance and plenty of revelations.
In Cornwall, artistic Zaya and Damian serve a modern British menu. Property developers Kelly and Jon show off their refurbished mansion. And Emma and Gavin host a fun-filled Cornish night.
In Cornwall, Marie and Gavin, Beki and Barry, and Sam and Nick compete in an eclectic edition featuring Friesian cows, pitchforks, and advice on how to survive a zombie apocalypse.
TGI Fridays opened in 1965 and became one of the world's biggest restaurant chains. CEO Ray Blanchette wants to re-energise the brand, and goes undercover to see what staff think.

Gordon heads to Brooklyn, New York, to tackle a sinking 55-year-old family restaurant. The owner, John Esposito, left high school at the age of 14 and has worked at his parents' business, Sal's Pizzeria, since.

Gordon heads to Wilkinsburg, Pennsylvania, home to Ms Jean's Southern Cuisine, which was opened 12 years ago by retired special education teacher Ms Jean Gould. Her employees say she's like Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde and that's why the local community stay away. Ms Jean insists she's only mean because her employees are lazy, but the business is falling apart.

Gordon Ramsay continues his travels across the United States in a bid to save failing restaurants from disaster. This week, Gordon visits beachside restaurant Barefoot Bob's in Hull, Massachusetts, owned by husband-and-wife team Marc and Lisa. The duo opened the grill in the summer of 2004 to a busy seafront crowd, but every year the bottom line collapses through the bleak winter months.
Gordon Ramsay revisits Café Hon in Hampden, Maryland, Chiarella's in Philadelphia, and Leone's in Montclair, New Jersey, to see whether the restaurant owners have taken his advice on board.

Gordon heads to the historic Olde Hitching Post in Hanson, Massachusetts, where he meets an owner so stubborn and set in his ways that he doesn't realise he's the reason his restaurant is losing money. Owner Tom bought the business for his daughter Andrea, but six years later he is still refusing to let her run it. Gordon must fight a controlling boss who doesn't react well to his criticism.
Jimmy Carr presides, while Jon Richardson and Bob Mortimer take on Sean Lock and Vic Reeves. Jack Whitehall joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while comedian Joe Wilkinson helps Rachel Riley.

Join Edinburgh Comedy Award Newcomer nominee Joe as he tackles the tyranny of Post Office jobsworths, confronts the stupidity of celebrities on Twitter and accidentally gets into an argument with Isis (not that one) in this Chortle Award-winning show recorded at the Duchess Theatre in London's West End.
Jimmy Carr hosts the topical comedy panel show, with team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock. The teams are joined by Jo Brand, Ronan Keating, Krishnan Guru-Murthy and James Acaster.

Jimmy Carr hosts the topical comedy panel show, with team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock. The teams are joined by guests Dr Christian Jessen, Lethal Bizzle, Joe Wilkinson and Aisling Bea for this edition.

The Goggleboxers watched 'Married at First Sight Australia', 'Wheel of Fortune', 'The Americas', 'Fear', 'Griff's Great Australian Rail Trip', 'Help! My House Is Haunted', 'BBC News (Trump vs Zelenskyy)' and 'ITV News (Zelenskyy in the UK)'.

More hopeful singletons visit the First Dates restaurant, including Ben, who sustained a brain injury in a road accident twelve years ago, Charlotte, a fellow Mancunian, and ambitious Megan, whose training schedule leaves her little time for love.

First through the restaurant door is six-foot four tattooed teetotaller Danny. This Brummie hunk wants a girl who'll accept him for who he is, and his match is Scouse mum of one Kate, a lady with a penchant for tattooed giants.

This week on the 'Box: Britain's Got Talent, Celebrity Hunted, Coronation Street, Michael McIntyre's Big Show, One Question, Boarders, The Fear Clinic: Face Your Phobia and BBC News and ITV News (Trump).
Carl tries to make a splash in Spain as he plans his big day with Rebecca, and he hopes she will swoon in delight at his designs.
Sofia and Craig from Luton have been a couple for eight years and even have their names tattooed on each. Now, Sofia wants a relaxed beach wedding, but Craig wants a wild party with lots of alcohol.
Adam writes an original script about Indiana Jones, but his passion for directing is challenged when he films it. Barry and Murray have a wager.

While the Keane family feud, Caleb's health takes a turn for the worse, and Frankie's determination to help him causes accusations to fly. Abigail pushes Dee Dee to audition for the lead role in the school play. And a couple plan their wedding.
Beverly nurses Coach Mellor back to health when he falls off the rope climbing equipment. Erica and her roommate get on each other's nerves.
Nightmare new neighbours descend on the Dunphys, while Jay is furious to learn that Manny is dating the granddaughter of a rival.
When Claire lets Phil take charge of Halloween, he decides to do something different from her usual fright-fest theme. Jay wants to be Prince Charming for Halloween.
Haley tries to land a job with an influential stylist while Gloria hires a hot Spanish teacher for Manny.
Claire has her doubts when Phil steps up to the plate to cook Thanksgiving dinner. Plus, roles are reversed after Cam is forced to play bad cop.

Gordon travels to Oakhurst, New Jersey, to help Mike Farber, the overwhelmed owner of Mike and Nellie's restaurant, who lost his way when Nellie, his father and business partner, died. Opened in 1996, the restaurant was a lifelong dream for the father and son. Alone at the helm, and still mourning the loss of his father, Mike has taken his eye off the ball and the restaurant has gone to pot.

Gordon travels to Austin, Texas, home to struggling restaurant El Greco, a business in danger of imminent collapse. El Greco is owned by mother and son Athina and Jake, and claims to be an authentic Greek restaurant. Much to Gordon's disgust, the duo have secretly recruited 'Chef Mike' the microwave to help them out on a daily basis.

Gordon's in the small community of Vernon Hills in northern Illinois, where mining-themed restaurant Wick 'n Ore is suffering an identity crisis. The 87-item menu is a confusing mix of cuisines that's putting the head chef under intense pressure.
It's a caramel quarter-final, and the bakers take on a classic treacle tart Signature and a towering millionaire shortbread Technical, and create spectacular nougatine sculpture showpieces.

When a straight-laced fire superintendent and his elite team of firefighters come to the rescue of three siblings, they quickly realize that no amount of training could prepare them for their most challenging job yet - babysitting.
Homer becomes a neighbourhood hero when, after wrecking his car in the snow, he buys a snowplough and clears his neighbours' driveways.

The family struggles to get Maggie to say her first word. Homer says he's glad that Maggie has not spoken yet because all Lisa and Bart do is talk back to him, but after he puts Maggie to bed, she says her first word.
When Homer learns he needs a heart bypass operation after having a heart attack at work, he searches for the cheapest doctor.

A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.

Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis, quickly christened 'Joker' by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant, and pudgy Private Lawrence, nicknamed 'Gomer Pyle', as they endure the rigours of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering, and eventually participating in, the Battle of Hue.

Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme.

Classic Oscar-winning tough comedy adventure set in First World War Africa featuring a hard-drinking, woman-hating owner of the 'African Queen', a decrepit steamer that trades up and down the river, and a strait-laced spinster sister of missionary Rev Samuel Sayer, whom he has agreed to take back to civilisation.

A sports agent who makes the mistake of saying what he believes finds himself sacked and abandoned by all his clients apart from small time footballer Rod Tidwell. Maguire's personal life starts to fall apart as he's torn between love and money in Cameron Crowe's metaphor on Americans' need for success and money.
A Secret Service agent-turned-bodyguard finds danger and romance while protecting an entertainer from a stalker.

Andy Dufresne and Ellis Boyd 'Red' Redding are two prisoners serving long sentences in the vicious Shawshank jail. The two come to terms with their imprisonment while surviving the sadistic acts of prison warden Samuel Norton, and for both, a different sort of redemption awaits.

Paul Edgecomb, the head guard of death row, just wants life for him, his colleagues and the condemned to be nice and easy. However, when John Coffey, a massive man convicted of brutally killing a pair of young sisters, arrives, things start to get strange. Beyond his simple, naïve nature and a deathly fear of the dark, Coffey seems to possess a prodigious, supernatural gift. Paul begins to question whether Coffey was truly guilty of murdering the two girls.
A rivalry comes about between two best friends when they each schedule their respective weddings on the same day.
A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.

A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.

Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished. Trying to help some teenagers, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now David's in big debt to his supplier, and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: he packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.

Jack Malik is a struggling singer-songwriter in an English seaside town whose dreams of fame are rapidly fading, despite the fierce devotion and support of his childhood best friend, Ellie. After a freak bus accident during a mysterious global blackout, Jack wakes up to discover that The Beatles have never existed. Performing songs by the greatest band in history to a world that has never heard them, Jack becomes on overnight sensation with a little help from his agent.

When cops Schmidt and Jenko join the secret Jump Street unit, they use their youthful appearances to go undercover as high-school students, trading in their guns and badges for backpacks, and setting out to shut down a dangerous drug ring.
Two police officers begin to question their partnership after each infiltrates different cliques while undercover at a local college.

Bart, a black railroad worker is appointed sheriff of a town marked for destruction by Hedley Lamarr, a scheming politician. As Lamarr tries to drive out the town's residents, Bart decides to stand in his way.
Asked to be maid of honour, the best friend of a bride must suddenly face off with an alpha bridesmaid, a woman who clearly wants to take over her job and her best friend status.

An unconventional sleuth attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami 🏈 [NFL] Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.

Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.
A group of good-hearted but incompetent misfits enter the police academy, but the instructors there are not going to put up with their pranks.

Mahoney and friends have graduated from the Police Academy and are issued with their first assignments. As before, their cheerfulness and devotion to duty outweighs any shortcomings, but are they ready to do battle with a band of graffiti daubing terrorists?

Slapstick farce with the incompetent cops as they set about saving their beloved academy from closure. Cutbacks mean that only one of the two police training schools can stay open, so Commandant Lassard appeals to the motley crew of graduates to come and train new recruits. However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.
In 2028, a robotics company sees a chance to bring its technology to American law enforcement by transforming a critically injured police officer into a cyborg.

It's Aks's prom night, but there are rumours about debauchery at previous proms and the threat of a stabbing. Things get more complicated when a classmate of Aks's, Ridwan, makes some unwise decisions that leave Mobeen very concerned.

When Aks breaks her shoulder and heads for hospital with the boys, Accident and Emergency is the state of play. With Mobeen, Eight and Nate looking shifty, the authorities start to get suspicious about how Aks may have sustained her injuries.

Cal, an old friend, makes an unexpected return to Small Heath, leaving Aks, Eight and Nate very concerned about what it means for Mobeen. They wonder whether he can stay clear of trouble, or if things are about to take a turn for the worse.

Dogs and ethnic minorities have a very bad track record, so when a clip involving Mobeen and an Alsatian goes viral, it's a disaster. Aks is drawn in by internet fame, while Mobeen tries to see if the spark between him and Miss Aitken, Aks's teacher, is worth pursuing. Three ghosts give a greedy network executive a long-overdue attitude adjustment over the Christmas period. Based on the Charles Dickens classic, 'A Christmas Carol'.

Two army buddies who have become entertainers travel to a Vermont ski resort for a well-earned rest. However, on arrival they find the resort, run by their old army commander, in need of a helping hand. There's only one answer, to put on a show.

The pupils at St Bernadette's primary school are on their best behaviour for the arrival of strict new teacher Mr Shepherd. But when he loses his memory, it's up to the kids to save the day.

Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.

Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve.

Weaving in and out of the love lives of eight loosely inter-related couples. The bachelor Prime Minister falls for his personal assistant, his brother-in-law is flirting with one of his colleagues, a writer heads off to France and pursues an affair with a maid, and an 11-year-old boy asks his father for advice on matters of the heart.

Dumped and depressed, English rose Iris agrees to swap homes with similarly unlucky in love Californian Amanda for a much-needed break. Iris finds herself in a palatial Hollywood mansion while Amanda navigates the lanes of a picture-perfect English village. Soon enough, both lovelorn ladies bump into local lads perfect for a romantic pick-me-up.
Ben would do anything to get out of Christmas at home, Michael and Alfie make the most of an empty house, and Janey learns that it's tough being a mum.

Get to know the family behind the clutter, hospital director Tash, tube driver Lawrence and their four kids, and find out why their home is making them miserable. There are emotional moments as the family go through treasured items, and friction develops as they must decide what to part with. The items they do decide to let go of will be put into piles to recycle, donate or sell.
The first immunity challenge requires the chefs to create delicious dishes inspired by judge Amaury Guichon's famous lifelike dessert masterpieces.
The Stoke crews cope with a major heart attack and a nasty football injury, while in Dudley, the paramedics help an elderly diabetic man with severe stomach pains.
The paramedic crews treat a drug user with a burst abscess, an elderly woman whose face has swollen, and a distraught young woman who may be suffering a miscarriage.
Paramedics attend an accident at a bus station, treat a feisty pensioner who has angina, a young mum with a suspected stroke, and a child hit by a cricket bat.
In Dudley, paramedics attend a road accident, while in Stoke, the crews work out how to move a woman with a bad fracture, and answer a call from a woman whose carer has fainted.
The paramedic crews are called to an unconscious child in a park, a seriously unwell man with blood in his colostomy bag, and a deaf woman with chest pains.
The crews reassure a frightened elderly patient with a dislocated hip, treat a baby with a dangerously high temperature, attend a woman with a fast heart rate and help an alcoholic.
The blue lights are flashing as the crews attend a woman with dangerously high blood pressure, a 20-year-old with chest pains, and a woman who has smashed her face in a fall.

Merida is a Rough Collie, diagnosed at 12 weeks with a developmental deformity. Bernese Mountain dog, six-year-old Brodie, has been diagnosed with a painful bulging disc. And a feisty six-year-old cat, Elmo, is referred after being hit by a car.
A French bulldog has an exploded disc and faces a high-risk operation. A cat called Nutty has a shattered radius after being shot with an airgun.

Gentle giant Bear, an English mastiff, visits Noel after suffering a painful ruptured cruciate ligament in his knee. Siamese cat Bluebell is rushed in after being hit by a car. Alongside a fractured pelvis, Noel suspects possible nerve damage.
Lola the beagle visits Noel after collapsing on her back legs, Brandi the chocolate Labrador refuses to walk, and bulldog puppy Molly is rushed in after being run over by a car.

Ruby the dachshund is rushed in after being run over by a car. Nine-year-old schnauzer Jess is booked in for spinal surgery. Pint-size shih tzu Ted has been injured at home. A CT scan shows that Ted has a broken right humerus.
It's almost Christmas and Fitzpatrick Referrals are as busy as ever with a rescue dog with bad discs and a German shepherd who gives his family and Noel an emotional ethical dilemma.
Pete helps train one of Dogs Trust's longest-staying residents and supports eleven Shih Tzus all rescued from the same household.

Nigella decamps to the countryside for a cosy Christmas. She throws a party, serving platters of devilled eggs and a sparkling cocktail, and creates a feast of roast duck with orange, soy and ginger alongside garlic and Parmesan mashed potato gratin.
Three-year-old Isaac has an operation on his tongue, Lynette has several toes straightened and David has biopsies taken from his prostate.
Nigel has keyhole surgery to repair his hernia, but things go wrong when he's back on the ward. Carol has a pin removed from her ankle, which was previously fractured.
An ambulance crew rush an elderly patient with suspected sepsis to hospital, and a little girl is reluctant to let the crew examine her cut head.

Devastated by the news he's to become a father, Smithy goes AWOL. The boys finally track him down, but can he be persuaded to do the right thing? Stacey is shocked to hear of Gwen's new domestic arrangements as the prospect of living in Essex finally hits her.

Stacey's brother Jason arrives home early, much to Uncle Bryn's horror. Stacey has her hen night and Gavin has two stag nights, the second of which reveals something about Stacey that could jeopardise the whole wedding.
The Shipmans drive down to Wales for the wedding fair, and after an eventful trip to church to hear the banns being read, Nessa confides in Stacey her big secret.

Stacey and Gavin return from honeymoon to a big welcome from both families. However, Smithy seems none too happy with his best mate and Nessa has a confession to make that throws the whole evening into disarray.
Del's latest foolproof scheme for making millions, game fishing, backfires when events take an unusual turn.
Love comes into Del's life when an old flame returns to London, but Rodney and Grandad are determined to extinguish the torch that Del is carrying.
Comedian Spike Dixon falls for Brenda and the feeling is mutual. The only problem is that his prospective father-in-law wants him to join the family business.

With the Trotters low on cash, Uncle Albert attempts to come to their rescue. When he falls through a pub cellar door, they attempt to sue for damages. Unfortunately, Uncle Albert's pulled this stunt a few times.

When the Trotters go shopping, they have no idea what's in store. The hapless trio end up being accused of shoplifting when they lose their receipts. In the manager's office, things go from bad to worse as they become involved in an armed robbery. The perpetrator turns out to be someone Del sold a dodgy watch to as the Trotters spend a long night with the gunman.
The committee members agree to erect a statue in the green, but they cannot find a heroic figure from Dibley's past.
The vicar is caught in a dilemma when David's handsome brother comes to stay, and risks the wrath of the villagers when she gives in to temptation.

The Bishop of Mulberry is to officiate at the christening of Alice and Hugo's baby. Geraldine and Owen are to be the godparents while Frank and Jim act as god-grandparents. When an amazed David finds that he and Geraldine are well-matched, he asks her to marry him.
An opportunity arises for Del to make his fortune, but a missing statue and gang warfare create problems.

Things have gone so well for the Trotters that Del and Rodney decide to treat Uncle Albert to a surprise birthday party. And Rodney has a night on the town with a date, but things don't quite go according to plan.

The Thames Valley Police provide a fascinating insight into car crime and its prevention, plus shocking video footage captures the dangerous behaviour of drivers in action.

A force-wide search is launched by the police when a man is assaulted by two men who also steal his car.

Simon and JK are in Amersham to assist with a raid on a suspected drug dealer. Rosie and Daz, coming to the end of their shift, are called in to assist with a driver who is both banned and not supposed to be in Reading.
A look at some dramatic footage of a dash cam capturing the collision of an SUV straight into an oncoming car.

David continues his exploration of the Great Barrier Reef aboard the research vessel Alucia, discovering its incredible annual visitors, from birds to whales, some of which travel thousands of kilometres to get there.

David attempts to understand what the next few decades hold for this remarkable community of animals, as well as what is being done to save it, whilst uncovering how scientists are trying to preserve the reef.

The gang decides to visit their pal, Professor Brikston, in the lost city of Byzantium, Turkey. The city is so lost that the only residents are the Professor, his helpers and a tar monster.

In the 1970s, young Gru tries to join a group of supervillains called the Vicious 6 after they oust their leader -- the legendary fighter Wild Knuckles. When the interview turns disastrous, Gru and his Minions go on the run with the Vicious 6 hot on their tails. Luckily, he finds an unlikely source for guidance -- Wild Knuckles himself -- and soon discovers that even bad guys need a little help from their friends.
Leonard tries to ease Penny's mind; Sheldon plans a special episode of "Fun With Flags"; Bernadette feels bad about keeping a secret.
A flat tire during Leonard's bachelor party weekend in Mexico tests the guys' skills; Penny is compelled to tell her family that she and Leonard eloped.
An impending change to his living arrangements inspires Sheldon to revert to 2003, before he met Penny and Leonard; Raj and Howard form a band.
Barry Kripke expresses interest in Amy while leading a fencing lesson for the guys; when Stuart tries to attract female customers to the store, Penny, Amy and Bernadette help out.
Leonard and Sheldon go to great lengths to secure the helium they need during a nation-wide shortage; Bernadette and Penny try to find Amy a new man on a dating app.
Rachel goes into labor, enduring endless pain while anxious Ross hovers nearby and her waiting friends wreak havoc in the hospital.
After Rachel gives birth to her baby, she must confront relationship issues around her.

Joey finds himself engaged to Rachel soon after she delivers her baby girl, while Phoebe assumes Ross is the one who proposed; Joey sneaks a peek as Rachel tries unsuccessfully to nurse; Monica and Chandler retire to a supply closet for privacy.
Joey seeks forgiveness from Ross, while Rachel tries to quell Emma's incessant crying.
Emma's pediatrician drops her as a patient because of Rachel's constant calls.
Ross mocks Rachel's new male nanny (Freddie Prinze Jr.); Chandler becomes upset when Monica says that somebody from her job is the funniest guy she's ever met.
Chandler and Joey find a videotape while checking out Richard's apartment; Ross sings Emma an off-color lullaby.

Rachel has a bone to pick with her self-centered sister (Christina Applegate) on Thanksgiving; Monica protects her good wedding china; Joey forgets to join his TV cast mates for the Thanksgiving parade.
Rachel impulsively gives her telephone number to a handsome guy but worries he will call when Ross is there.
SpongeBob can't shake a group of elves who want to repay him for a good deed; a mime begins following (and imitating) SpongeBob, much to his annoyance.
Sandy seeks Squidward's help to heal her sick tree, but his alternative gardening methods give her a headache; SpongeBob and Squidward search for the perfect birthday present for Mr. Krabs.

Having made a big blunder in a recent rescue, Zuma trades in his usual chill attitude and becomes a super serious pup; his new persona gets tested when an actual pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and willing to destroy things to get it!
SpongeBob visits his old pal Bubble Buddy's hometown, Bubbletown; Sandy invites Karen and Mrs. Puff out for a night on the town, so the ladies decide to blow off some steam.
Mr. Krabs has an accident and leaves SpongeBob in charge of the Krusty Krab; Patrick takes a job at the Goofy Goober when he finds out the employees get free ice cream.
SpongeBob and Patrick create their own zoo that is made entirely of bubbles; the Krusty Krab goes under emergency quarantine, but no one knows who is carrying the mysterious illness.

Now that Gru has forsaken a life of crime to raise Margo, Agnes and Edith, he's trying to figure out how to provide for his new family. As he struggles with his responsibilities as a father, the Anti-Villain League, an organization dedicated to fighting evil, comes calling. The AVL sends Gru on a mission to capture the perpetrator of a spectacular heist, for who would be better than the world's greatest ex-villain to capture the individual who seeks to usurp his power.

The mischievous Minions hope that Gru will return to a life of crime after the new boss of the Anti-Villain League fires him. Instead, Gru decides to remain retired and travel to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother for the first time. The reunited siblings soon find themselves in an uneasy alliance to take down the elusive Balthazar Bratt, a former 1980s child star who seeks revenge against the world.

Evolving from single-celled yellow organisms at the dawn of time, Minions live to serve, but find themselves working for a continual series of unsuccessful masters, from T. Rex to Napoleon. Without a master to grovel for, the Minions fall into a deep depression. But one minion, Kevin, has a plan; accompanied by his pals Stuart and Bob, Kevin sets forth to find a new evil boss for his brethren to follow. Their search leads them to Scarlet Overkill, the world's first-ever super-villainess.

When the Dizzy Dust Express appears with no one aboard, the PAW Patrol must stop the runaway train and find the missing passengers; Ms. Marjorie, Tilly Turbot and Mayor Goodway get stranded in the treetops on their jungle zip-lining adventure.
The cheetah has a nefarious plan to destroy the jungle and build the cheating-est racetrack ever.

When Mayor Humdinger's mom loses her son's phony trophy, the PAW Patrol have to rescue her and its secret stash of treats; when Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta get trapped inside a mesa, it's up to the PAW Patrol and a little snake to rescue them.
Uncle Otis takes a trip to gold mine; Uncle Otis installs a Smart Home 3000 in his cabin that ends up trapping him and Mr. Wingnut inside.
Humdinger's hands are full when he babysits his new friend's kids; Everest helps the pups rescue both mayors trapped inside a greenhouse.

When Mayor Humdinger runs for mayor of Adventure Bay, his Mayor Mobile runs out of control; when Ryder and the pups visit Tracker and Carlos in the jungle, a group of monkeys finds itself in sticky bubble trouble.

Skye, Everest, Liberty and Katie go on a camping adventure where they encounter a polar bear with a sweet tooth; when Julia and Julius put on a magic show, they are convinced they accidentally turned Mr. Carter into a rabbit.
Cap'n Turbot's boat gets frozen in the Arctic ice; the pups use the Sea Patroller to help guide a lost narwhal back home.

When Francois and Cap'n Turbot get stranded on a remote island, Ryder and the pups must fly in to rescue the bickering cousins; the pups must come to the rescue when Mayor Goodway's first flying lesson goes awry.

Carlos and Tracker make PawPaw juice with the PAW Patrol when they find out Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta are in trouble; Farmer Al needs help saving his corn crop after the top of his silo gets knocked off.
The children try to figure out how to get Mr. Grouper's car started after it breaks down on the way to an amusement park.
When the evil robot Major Bummer tries to eliminate music from the galaxy, Princess Molly and the Guppies must restore peace, harmony and melody.
The children try to teach Mr. Grumpfish about their favorite things when he is their substitute teacher.
The team must search the Umi City Carnival for Jake's lost stuffed animal.
The team must use The Incredible Presto's wand to save him before his magic show.
Shortly after listening to the story of Thundermouth, the pups are on a mission to save elephants spooked by a scary noise; Mayor Goodway is left in charge of a class pet, but the hamster escapes.
The Mighty Pups get charged up to take on new superbaddie the Copycat; it will take all-new powers and gear to take down their most formidable foe to date.
Chase and the team get called to Barkingburg to keep an eye on the crown.
When Speed Meister steals Rubble and Crew's bus, the pups have to stop it in time for Sierra Sparkle's big concert; if Rubble and Crew build a lifeguard tower, the beach can open.

When Rubble's favorite baseball star Aaron Judge can't get out of town to the home run derby, Rubble & Crew build a stadium to hold the derby right in Builder Cove; Surf's up for Rubble & Crew, if they can get over the super hot sand.
Rubble gets into trouble while pretending to be a super pup; the PAW Patrol must help Ryder find his robot pup.
Ryder and the pups must keep Giant Alex busy so that he does not cause damage in Adventure Bay; the PAW Patrol must rescue Cap'n Turbot's cousin.

When pirates Alex, Julia, Julius and Chick-ARR-letta set sail into the desert and become lost, it's up to the PAW Patrol to save the land pirates; Cap'n Turbot and Francois chirp for help when a bird-watching contest leaves them up in the air.
Mayor Humdinger plans to cheat in the annual Mayor's Race; Ryder and Mayor Goodway find a treasure map while sorting through the old cabin of Outlaw Wild Wilbur.

Peppa and her family collect blackberries; Mrs. Zebra teaches the children to make pottery; Daddy Pig's work papers are accidentally turned into paper airplanes; Edmond Elephant's birthday party; a flood turns Peppa's house into a desert island.

Peppa plays with Freddy Fox at his apartment; Peppa and family help everyone in the apartments make a garden; Peppa plays with Candy Cat; Peppa plays with all of her different friends in each of their apartments.
Mandy Mouse makes a birthday visit to a cheese theme park; Madame Gazelle introduces the children to poetry; Daddy Pig suggests that Peppa and George play a game.

Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit are stranded on a desert island; everyone goes boating at the lake; Daddy Pig is left behind; Peppa and her friends build a desert island in the sandpit; Peppa takes Goldie to the aquarium.

Peppa's family goes on holiday in their camper van; Peppa and George learn about compost; Richard Rabbit comes to play with George; Daddy Pig runs a race to raise money; Peppa sees a rainbow.

The pups help fill the pool; the pups help sea turtle hatchlings; the pups clean up an oil spill; Walinda gets tangled in an anchor chain; the team helps a monkey; Cap'n Turbot's boat runs aground; Adventure Bay Race Day; the team helps a dolphin.
Cap'n Turbot speaks fluent alien while stranded with an Alien Grandpa; a lemon-loving duckling from Yumi's Farm disrupts a delivery to Lizzy's Lemonade Shoppe.
When giant balloons float away from a parade, it's up to the pups to save the pup balloons, the parade and Mayor Humdinger; the Turbot cousins try to spot a rare spider but get stuck in its web.

The PAW Patrol is on a roll when squirrels stash acorns in Alex's treehouse, causing it to fall onto Daring Danny's skateboard; a switcheroo situation develops when a joey is separated from its mother.
A mighty wind sweeps Zuma and Harrigan off the beach and blows them all the way up to Jake's Mountain; Humdinger's driving lands him and his trailer at the top of a tall spire.

Rocky must rescue himself after being stranded on an island full of trash by Mayor Humdinger; Daring Danny's new remote control accidentally takes control of Everest's SnoCat and all the vehicles in Adventure Bay.
The Pups must save Rocky and Humdinger from a runaway box fort; when Skye helps Traveling Travis search for Big Bill Island, the misguided explorer gets carried away by a really, really big bird.
Arrby recruits a crew of meerkats to gather magical seeds; Mayor Humdinger wants a hippo as his new hench-animal, but needs a rescue when it gallops off with Humdinger on its back.
An escaped monkey leads the PAW Patrol on a chase through Adventure Bay; the PAW Patrol saves a baby owl and reunites him with his mother.

The PAW Patrol searches for missing sheep; Ryder and Chase search for missing songbirds; Katie's kittens run amuck; Zuma goes on a wacky windsurfing water rescue; the pups help Carlos find his lost parrot; the PAW Patrol helps Priscilla the pony.

When Sandy tries to study SpongeBob and Patrick's behavioral patterns, her science experiment goes awry; after following Plankton's advice, Mr. Krabs decides to marry the only thing he has ever loved - money.

Patrick leads an enthusiastic stranger on a tour of his favorite places in Bikini Bottom; SpongeBob is afraid to get off the roof of the Krusty Krab, but he will not let that stop him from living his life.

After arriving one minute late for work, SpongeBob decides to move into the Krusty Krab so that he will never be late again; when Plankton secretly turns down the thermostat at the Krusty Krab the entire restaurant freezes over.
Lady Upturn becomes Squidward's patron and introduces his music to her rich friends; Squidward tries to disprove aliens until he has a close encounter with one.
When SpongeBob unknowingly breaks a witch's curse, its victim insists on being cursed again; Larry begins to emulate Patrick when he finds out about his secret super strength.
The Gal Pals take Pearl to a cabin in the woods for a weekend of silly pranks; Mr. Krabs has a secret taste for something surprising.
SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward squeeze inside a tiny treehouse; SpongeBob adopts a stray seahorse.
SpongeBob is desperate to meet his newest hero, Kenny the Cat; Mr. Krabs tries to scare Squidward into working harder.
In prehistoric Bikini Bottom, SpongeGar, Patar, and Squog discover fire.
Squidward takes a new job as manager of Weenie Hut Jr's; Squidward gets trapped on his way to return a nearly overdue library book.
When the key to the vault holding the Krabby Patty recipe is lost, SpongeBob must locate it before the recipe is lost forever.
SpongeBob and Patrick fear the new roller coaster at Bikini Bottom's amusement park; Plankton tricks SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward into fixing up the Chum Bucket.
A new secret Krabby Patty formula has disastrous results for Bikini Bottom, and only SpongeBob can save the day; Mr. Krabs and Plankton have to take boating school classes.
The houses on Conch Street come alive and go on an adventure to save Patrick's rock; Sandy upgrades SpongeBob with robotic parts after he injures his patty flipping arm.
SpongeBob experiences a bad luck streak when his lucky tie clip suddenly goes missing.
Squidward's new life is threatened; stuck in her dome, Sandy suspects Plankton's up to no good and gets Patrick to investigate.
SpongeBob discovers that Squidward has never actually tried a Krabby patty; a bully threatens SpongeBob.
SpongeBob and Patrick dig a tunnel between their houses; Patrick wreaks havoc in Bikini Bottom when he learns karate.

Squidward must figure out whodunit after a mysterious stranger vandalizes Mrs. Puff's Boating School; Squidward enters a gardening competition but struggles to keep up with SpongeBob's naturally green thumb.
When Mr. Krabs gets in trouble for littering, he makes SpongeBob and Squidward clean up Bikini Bottom; a sea bunny ravages Squidward's garden, but SpongeBob thinks it's cute.
SpongeBob has trouble letting go of a perfect Krabby Patty; Squidward's personality changes when his security fence electrocutes him.
After the Science Scouts begin selling biscuits to fund a trip to Mars, Mr. Krabs enters the ring and turns it into a competition; a new driving school opens in town.
Mr. Krabs fires SpongeBob to save money; SpongeBob tries to get back to work.
SpongeBob must go to extreme lengths when Gary refuses to go to the vet; SpongeBob gets stuck while working out.

Plankton needs help stealing the formula, so he hires an intern who knows more about Mr. Krabs than anyone; Patrick goes into a destructive fit whenever he hears a bell, so his friends help him in their own ways.
SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward are locked in a time capsule; SpongeBob and Patrick build a dream world for Squidward.
Mr. Krabs and SpongeBob hide the health inspector's body; SpongeBob and Patrick throw out their new TV and keep the box.
SpongeBob falls asleep on the bus and ends up in a town full of Bikini Bottom doppelgängers; after Squidward loses his memory, he adopts a new tough guy persona.

When his clarinet goes missing, Squidward must become a hard-boiled detective to track it down; Squidward sends SpongeBob and Patrick on an increasingly difficult scavenger hunt to get them out of his hair.
Mr. Krabs makes a wish that he could talk to money; SpongeBob competes against a patty-making machine; Squidward trains SpongeBob for a dance contest.
When SpongeBob fails his driver's test again, Mr. Krabs decides to teach him how to drive; SpongeBob gets lost while trying to take a shortcut to work.
SpongeBob and Patrick throw snowballs at Squidward; Mr. Krabs has a garage sale.

Bubble Bass avoids paying his bill at the Krusty Krab, so SpongeBob and Squidward are sent to collect the cash; Mr. Krabs makes SpongeBob and Squidward cook a fancy meal for Mrs. Puff, but every dish becomes a dispute.
SpongeBob orders a product that will help him learn to say no; SpongeBob gets a song stuck in his head.
DoodleBob bites SpongeBob, transforming him into a WereDoodle; SpongeBob dresses up for Gorilla Suit Day and is mistaken for a real gorilla.
SpongeBob's new friend is a giant, fluffy hamster that no one else can see; Patrick wants to be a horse.
SpongeBob becomes a local sensation after a food critic gives him high ratings; SpongeBob helps Patrick promote a song that he wrote.
The friends become unstoppable after Sandy teaches them karate; before long, the entire town learns the martial art and joins the action.

Squidward receives an invitation to a gallery opening and scrambles to find a friend to take with him; while trying to order a special sandwich, Patrick gets swept up in the fast-paced world of business.
Stardom goes to SpongeBob's head after he appears in Krabs' low-budget commercial; Squidward becomes impoverished.
Mrs. Puff sends SpongeBob far away to a driving school in Klopnod; Slappy brings his macabre sensibilities to the Krusty Krab when he's hired there as a server.
SpongeBob and Patrick are sent to jail in the underground tunnels of Glove World, leading to a daring escape.
Plankton masquerades as Gary to steal the Krabby Patty formula; SpongeBob and Patrick play hide and seek.
Gary has a pet translation collar, and he's talking up a storm; when a small clown gets left behind by the circus, SpongeBob takes the hapless harlequin under his wing.

When Squidward sets out to prove that anyone can write a comic book, his work garners an obsessed fan base; an actor shadows SpongeBob in preparation for his next big movie, but his dedication to the role becomes a headache for SpongeBob.
Mr. Krabs throws a company picnic to boost morale, but Plankton hosts his own picnic on the same day; Mr. Krabs tells SpongeBob tales from his old navy days.
SpongeBob and Patrick try to help Sandy rid her dome of fleas; Patrick accidentally takes SpongeBob's doughnut; SpongeBob washes dishes at the Krusty Krab.
SpongeBob tries to convince a bouncer that he is tough enough for the Salty Spitoon; Squidward's archenemy returns.
Squidward spends a day at the laundromat with his fellow Bikini Bottomites; SpongeBob and Patrick must track down Old Man Jenkins' prized worm hog.
The Krusty Krab crew goes to a big concert to sell Krabby Patties in the stands; SpongeBob explores the melodious dreamscapes of his sleeping neighbors.
When a new internet celebrity causes havoc in Swellview, Captain Man has to swap bodies with Frankini to infiltrate his secret lair.
Kid Danger and Captain Man attempt to capture mob boss Rob Moss by infiltrating his daughter's Sweet 16 birthday party.
A villain's dream beam traps Henry in a dream state from which only Charlotte can rescue him.
After Henry uses his new power to compete in a Dodge-A-Leen tournament, Ray, Schwoz and Charlotte go undercover to teach Henry a lesson.
Henry is grounded after he is caught sneaking out at night; while Piper drives Henry crazy at home, Charlotte steps into the sidekick role.
Lincoln begins to hog the spotlight when he becomes Luan's clown assistant; the Loud children have fun on a snow day.
When Lola gets sick and is unable to compete in a pageant, Lincoln coaches Lana to take her place; thinking it will be easy, Lincoln and Clyde decide to take on the task of baby-sitting Lily.

When a fancy grocery store opens on the block, Bobby rallies the family to do everything they can to compete; Ronnie Anne fakes being sick to watch a Lucha Libre match, which proves to be more difficult than anticipated.
When Gramps struggles to run Camp Mastodon, the kids come to his rescue; the Loud kids help Lana get over her fear of sleepovers.
Lincoln has his hands full when all 10 of his sisters ask him to cover for them on the same day; Bobby and Lori go on a double date with Lincoln and Bobby's little sister, Ronnie Anne.

Lincoln must beat each of his sisters to the couch in order to watch the finale of his favorite show; Lincoln leaves a scathing voicemail on Lori's phone, and quickly realizes that he must erase it before she hears it.
Lincoln must care for the class tarantula; Lincoln decides to go on strike until someone will swap chores.

Finally tired of doing favors for Lori to get rides, Lincoln decides to help Leni pass her driver's test; Lincoln and nine of his sisters work as a team to thwart the tyranny they face with Lori as their babysitter.

All ten of Lincoln's sisters want to use the new kiddie pool he has purchased, but it is not large enough for all of them; after noticing that none of his sisters share his interests, Lincoln tries to mold Lily into his mini-me.

Worried that his teacher has bad things to say about him, Lincoln tries to delay his parent-teacher conference; Luan wakes up with a pimple on the day of her first date with Benny, so she turns to the siblings for help.
Lincoln is convinced the middle school lunch lady is holding a grudge against him and his older sisters; Mr. Grouse attempts to find some peace and quiet after moving away from the Louds.

When Dad discovers that his childhood camp is closing, he decides to take the family for one final visit; they soon uncover a map that could lead to a treasure big enough to save the camp and prove the existence of an old camp legend.

To make it to school, the Louds must survive a monstrous Lynn when the weatherman declares it a Packing Day; when there are signs of a yeti in Royal Woods, the Action News Team sets out to prove its existence.
Lincoln spills one of Lisa's experiments, setting off a chain reaction throughout the house; Lincoln tries to encourage the family to stop using so much electricity.

Lynn tries to stall her friends from riding the new coaster at Dairyland, before they find out her secret; after Lola and Mr. Grouse find a precious gem, the two struggle to decide who gets to watch over it.

Leni and Carlota's working styles clash when they are both interning for a famous fashion designer, Mariella Moss; the Louds book a stay at an all-inclusive resort, only to find the vacation is not what they imagined.
Howard and Harold tear their home apart after Clyde starts spending more time with the gang and less time at home; Sunset Canyon is falling apart and Lincoln and Clyde are determined to find out why.

A tale of a young girl's close encounter with the galaxy's most wanted extraterrestrial. Lilo is a lonely Hawaiian girl who adopts a small ugly "dog," whom she names Stitch. Stitch would be the perfect pet if he weren't in reality a genetic experiment who has escaped from an alien planet and crash-landed on Earth. Through her love, faith and unwavering belief in ohana, the Hawaiian concept of family, Lilo helps unlock Stitch's heart and gives him the ability to care for someone else.

In this classic Walt Disney animation based on Rudyard Kipling's book, Mowgli, an abandoned child raised by wolves, has his peaceful existence threatened by the return of the man-eating tiger Shere Khan. Facing certain death, Mowgli must overcome his reluctance to leave his wolf family and return to the "man village." Workaholic Howard Langston (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wants to make things up to his son, Jamie (Jake Lloyd), and wife, Liz (Rita Wilson). He promises to get Jamie the hottest toy of the season, Turbo-Man -- even though it's Christmas Eve and the toy is practically sold out. As Langston hunts down the elusive gift, he runs into mailman Myron (Sinbad), another father on the same quest. With the clock winding down, Langston's moral code is tested as he starts to learn the real meaning of Christmas.

The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbors in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realizes there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.

An amiable rooster called Alan-a-Dale (Roger Miller) tells stories and sings songs of the heroic Robin Hood (Brian Bedford) and his trusty sidekick, Little John (Phil Harris), in this animated animal-themed adaptation of the legendary story. When evil Prince John (Peter Ustinov) deputizes the Sheriff of Nottingham (Pat Buttram) to collect unreasonable taxes from the animals of Sherwood Forest, Robin, Little John and the other merry men wage a lighthearted battle against their evil foes.

In this Disney animated film, Wendy and her two brothers are amazed when a magical boy named Peter Pan flies into their bedroom, supposedly in pursuit of his rebellious shadow. He and his fairy friend, Tinker Bell, come from a far-off place called Neverland, where children stay perpetually young. Enchanted, the kids follow him back. But when Pan's nemesis, the pirate Captain Hook, causes trouble, the kids begin to miss their old life.

When the woodworker Geppetto (Christian Rub) sees a falling star, he wishes that the puppet he just finished, Pinocchio (Dickie Jones), could become a real boy. In the night, the Blue Fairy (Evelyn Venable) grants Geppetto's wish and asks Jiminy Cricket (Cliff Edwards) to serve as the wooden boy's conscience. But the naive and trusting Pinocchio falls into the clutches of the wicked Honest John (Walter Catlett), who leads him astray to the sinful Pleasure Island.

Divorced dad Scott (Tim Allen) has custody of his son (Eric Lloyd) on Christmas Eve. After he accidentally kills a man in a Santa suit, they are magically transported to the North Pole, where an elf explains that Scott must take Santa's place before the next Christmas arrives. Scott thinks he's dreaming, but over the next several months he gains weight and grows an inexplicably white beard. Maybe that night at the North Pole wasn't a dream after all -- and maybe Scott has a lot of work to do.
Years after a college newsroom mishap sent Meg and Billy down opposite life paths, the pair reunite in the small Texas town of Fern where they must team up to save the town's Christmas Roundup.
Marty gets caught in a time loop on Christmas Eve -- and he loves it. Then he meets down-on-her-luck Chloe, and for the first time since the loop started, he wants to see Christmas day.
Estranged sisters team up to get their father a date by Christmas to fulfill their late mother's final wish.

When Darcy returns to her hometown for Christmas, and she reconnects with Luke, a former rival, they must plan a charity event together. As she spends time with her family and Luke, she starts to realize what matters most in life.
When an assistant gives her final notice, she is drawn into helping the younger brother of her boss as he looks after his orphaned nieces and nephew through Christmas.

Old high school rivals must put aside their differences as they work together on a fundraising event for a damaged temple. In doing so, they soon discover that teamwork can move mountains and open hearts, including their own.

While she has no idea who her new husband is, her longtime admirer, Norval Jones (Eddie Bracken), seizes the opportunity to help. When Trudy's cop father (William Demarest) catches wind of the situation, however, wacky misunderstandings follow, with the well-meaning Norval on the wrong side of the law.

But when Polly returns earlier than expected, and Andy's neighbor Betsy (Judy Garland) shows up claiming to have a crush on him, Andy realizes that he has more girls than he can handle.

Sheriff Chadbourne (Samuel Herrick) transports convict Ben Trask (Lloyd Bridges) to El Paso in a covered wagon. The wagon also carries sea captain Theodore Bess (Lee J. Cobb) and married couple Laura (Marie Windsor) and Jerry Niblett (Dean Train). The group comes upon a wounded Native American, banished by his tribe, who offers to lead them to gold. But then the tribe attacks the wagon, killing Jerry and wounding Chadbourne. Ben is freed to help, but the group's troubles have only begun.

Working undercover, Smiley learns that Jules Brissac (Eugene Borden), the area's biggest and most ruthless fur trapper, has been working with the local tribes to scare off the settlers who are ruining his lucrative business.

A vicious outlaw called Pecos Pete (Onslow Stevens) has long tormented the peaceful residents of a small frontier town. So these desperate people hire a dedicated new sheriff, Tex Miller (Glenn Ford), to bring this ruffian to justice. But, for all his determination, Tex is tricked by Pete and led into an ambush. Ultimately, it is the wily and brassy transplant Belinda "Bill" Pendergast (Penny Singleton) who uncovers Pete's true identity and plots a way to run him out of town once and for all.
